request: At DeleteSpaceMember handler entry, compare removal of the caller's own active membership with removal of a different active member's membership in the same space. Assume resource resolution succeeds. Report source-visible authorization and the accepted-policy comparison separately.

policySources.text: An active space member may delete their own membership to leave. Removing a different active member requires space administrator authority.

acceptance.reason: This is the original accepted policy for the task.
